fusions.name: Fetch Disc
fusions.desc: Throws a bladed disc at an enemy up to 6 tiles away that deals 8 damage, rising to 1.6 times that at maximum range. Holds 3 charges; each use spends one, and each kill brings one back to your hand.

fusions.name: Lockjaw Actuator
fusions.desc: A weapon strike that locks a geared jaw on the target, which deals 18 damage, uses up every affliction you have on it and deals 60% more damage for each one. It then leaves the target [Bleeding] for 3 damage a second for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Brass Mastiff
fusions.desc: Winds up a brass hound that fights beside you for 15 seconds. It deals 5 damage to an enemy within 4 tiles every 1.2 seconds, each bite with a 25% chance to leave it [Pinned] for 1.5 seconds.

fusions.name: Scent Tracker
fusions.desc: You deal 10% more damage to enemies carrying your afflictions.
